mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MEMBER_SOCIAL ( SOCIAL_NO, MEMBER_NO, PROVIDER, PROVIDER_USER_ID, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_MEMBER_SOCIAL_NO.NEXTVAL, #{memberNo}, #{provider}, #{providerUserId}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT M.MEMBER_NO AS memberNo, M.MEMBER_ID AS memberId, M.MEMBER_NAME AS memberName, M.NICKNAME AS nickname, M.EMAIL AS email, M.PHONE AS phone, M.PROFILE_IMAGE AS profileImage, M.ROLE AS role, M.STATUS AS status, MS.SOCIAL_NO AS socialNo, MS.PROVIDER AS provider, MS.PROVIDER_USER_ID AS providerUserId, MS.CREATED_AT AS socialCreatedAt FROM MEMBER_SOCIAL MS JOIN MEMBER M ON MS.MEMBER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO WHERE MS.PROVIDER = #{provider} AND MS.PROVIDER_USER_ID = #{providerUserId}
